Not just keeping up, but setting the pace, this sleek AI powerhouse is shaping the future, making every moment of creation as bold as your ideas. Welcome to the next evolution of computing.

feature_entries.title: Copilot+ PCs. A new AI era begins.
feature_entries.description: New AI superpowers. Discover the power of Recall (preview), improved Windows search, and Click to Do (preview) on Copilot+ PCs. Effortlessly locate past content, perform natural searches, and interact with text and images – all while ensuring your data remains private and you stay productive*.

feature_entries.title: Get a fresh perspective with Windows 11
feature_entries.description: From a rejuvenated Start menu, to new ways to connect to your favorite people, news, games, and content—Windows 11 is the place to think, express, and create in a natural way.

feature_entries.title: Snapdragon X Elite Processor
feature_entries.description: Calling all coders, editors, performance seekers, and content producers—Snapdragon X Elite Processors enable the fastest, most intelligent Windows PCs ever built.

feature_entries.title: Ultimate performance and efficiency for complex workloads.
feature_entries.description: Snapdragon X Elite enables the fastest, most intelligent Windows PCs ever built—up to 90% faster than other processors when unplugged**

feature_entries.title: PureSight 3K 14.5" OLED Display
feature_entries.description: Step into a new visual era with the Yoga Slim 7x's PureSight OLED display, refreshing your perspective at 90Hz. With 3K resolution, 100% DCI-P3 coverage and a whopping 1000 peak nits HDR (500 nits SDR) of brightness, every detail pops in stark, vivid color. It's not just a touchscreen — it's a window to a world where visuals are more lively and bright.

feature_entries.title: Lenovo AI Core
feature_entries.description: Lenovo AI Core directs Snapdragon X Elite for peak efficiency. The AI Core informs Snapdragon of your activities, fine-tuning performance for your exact needs. It's a concerto of efficiency for creatives — a system attuned to anticipate your moves and optimize power precisely to your workflow, extending battery life. Together, they don't just adapt; they evolve with you.

feature_entries.title: Light. Tough. Super sleek.
feature_entries.description: Embrace creativity on the move with the Yoga Slim 7x. Just 2.82 lbs and .51 in thin, this MIL-STD 810H marvel combines sleek design with solid durability. Its Comfort Edge makes holding and creating on the go a breeze, proving it's built for dynamic creators.

feature_entries.title: Premium Suite
feature_entries.description: Level up the way you interact with your device thanks to the Premium Suite. Command any space with studio-grade mics, dive into cinematic sound with Dolby Atmos speakers, and always look sharp with the FHD MIPI IR camera. Plus, an intuitive keyboard and enlarged trackpad await your next flash of inspiration.

products.page_description: Fuel your future and power your passions with the Legion 7i, available in stunning Glacier White. The Legion 7i delivers cutting-edge AI-tuned technology to power through games, streams, and everything in between. Equipped with the latest Intel Core Ultra processors, next-gen NVIDIA GeForce RTX graphics, and Lenovo AI Engine+ with dedicated Lenovo AI Core (LA3), the Legion 7i maximizes FPS, enhances streams, and speeds through projects with ease. Seamlessly engineered to stay cool and quiet, it’s powered by Legion Coldfront: Hyper. Lenovo PureSight OLED gaming displays offer breathtaking visuals, low latency, and precise color accuracy while extending battery life. Legion Space introduces a new software suite with integrated AI experiences. Thinner, lighter, and built for gamers on the go, the Legion 7i is the perfect companion for all your pursuits.

feature_entries.title: Windows 11 operating system
feature_entries.description: Windows 11 brings back the Start Menu from Windows 7 and introduces new features, like the Edge Web browser that lets you markup Web pages on your screen.

feature_entries.title: Copilot in Windows 11 - Get answers, inspiration, and summaries
feature_entries.description: Find the relevant information and ideas you need to power your own ingenuity. Copilot in Windows 11 can deliver answers that are more relevant to you.

feature_entries.title: Intel Core Ultra 7 Series 2
feature_entries.description: 15th Gen Intel Core Ultra processors deliver uncompromised performance and power efficiency for the enthusiast gamer and gaming content creator. 20-Core 3D performance hybrid architecture with powerful NPU and GPU built-in, 15th Gen Intel Core Ultra HX processors are the platform built for the most ambitious tasks. Crafted for mobile devices, it brings the flexibilty to supercharge gaming or workflows anywhere, anytime.

feature_entries.title: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50 Series
feature_entries.description: Powered by NVIDIA Blackwell, GeForce RTX 50 Series Laptop GPUs bring game-changing capabilities to gamers and creators. Equipped with a massive level of AI horsepower, the RTX 50 Series enables new experiences and next-level graphics fidelity. Multiply performance with NVIDIA DLSS 4, generate images at unprecedented speed, and unleash your creativity with NVIDIA Studio. All in the thinnest and longest lasting RTX laptops, optimized by Max-Q.

feature_entries.title: Lenovo PureSight OLED Gaming Display
feature_entries.description: Enjoy high-fidelity gaming, precise color accuracy, and extended battery life with Lenovo PureSight OLED displays. Fast response times, flexible refresh rates, and AI-driven adjustments keep your visuals sharp and smooth. Anti-Burn-In Technology ensures long-lasting performance.

feature_entries.title: Legion Coldfront: Hyper
feature_entries.description: Legion Coldfront: Hyper keeps your system cool with turbo fans, 3D heatpipes, and AI tuning. Switch modes with Fn+Q, while Acoustic AI Sound Sync adjusts performance for seamless gaming.

feature_entries.title: Nahimic by SteelSeries Audio for Games
feature_entries.description: Nahimic by SteelSeries leverages AI technology to deliver immersive 3D audio and tailored sound profiles, transforming your gaming experience. Nahimic’s AI Smart Profile adjusts audio settings automatically, ensuring you’re always in the game’s sweet spot.

feature_entries.title: Legion TrueStrike Keyboard
feature_entries.description: Master precision with the Legion TrueStrike keyboard - designed for accuracy in gaming. This full-sized keyboard, with dedicated arrow keys, a number pad, and a Mylar touchpad, is perfect for 3D renderwork or gaming. Customize per-key RGB lighting through Lenovo Spectrum and sync it via Legion Space for the ideal setup.

products.page_description: Galaxy Book5 Pro gives you premium performance and pro-level power in a device designed to move as fast as you do. From creating presentations to editing large files, the AI-powered Intel Core Ultra 7 processor makes it all feel unbelievably fast and smooth. With its lightweight build and long-lasting battery, you can seamlessly transition from your desk to a cafe to a client meeting without missing a beat. Packed with cutting-edge technology, Book5 Pro has smart features like AI Select¹ and Copilot AI assistance to help you simplify complex tasks and streamline your workflow. Because work rarely happens on just one device, Book5 Pro is also built with advanced features that make it easy to work in sync with the rest of your Galaxy devices. Get an important notification or need to respond to a text mid-project? Phone Link ² puts your phone screen right on Book5 Pro, allowing you to access all your important phone features and control it right from your PC. Sharing big files between your devices? With Quick Share³ you can do it wirelessly, quickly and safely. Plus, Auto Hotspot⁴ kicks in when your Wi-Fi doesn’t, so your laptop stays connected even when your day takes a detour. No matter where work takes you, Galaxy Book5 Pro keeps you a step ahead.

feature_entries.title: Copilot+ PCs. A new AI era begins.
feature_entries.description: Turn your ideas from text prompts into generated artwork. With Recall*, search across time to find the content you need. Understand new languages instantly with Live Captions. With Copilot+ PCs, you will be all set to transform the way you create, find and communicate. Some Copilot+ PC experiences require free updates continuing to roll out through early 2025. Timing varies by device and region. See aka.ms/copilotpluspcs

feature_entries.title: Get a fresh perspective with Windows 11
feature_entries.description: From a rejuvenated Start menu, to new ways to connect to your favorite people, news, games, and content—Windows 11 is the place to think, express, and create in a natural way.

feature_entries.title: The latest Intel processordriving this next gen AI PC
feature_entries.description: Experience a new level of transformative AI performance on Galaxy Book5 Pro with the super fast Intel Core Ultra processor (Series 2), upgraded graphics and an advanced NPU capable of up to 47 TOPS. Harness all that power to blaze through heavy workloads, render complex models and easily complete AI-intensive tasks with incredible speed.

feature_entries.title: Vivid visuals and dazzling views at your fingertips
feature_entries.description: From detailed presentations to enjoying vibrant content, it all looks captivating on the 3K Dynamic AMOLED 2x display with touchscreen, featuring 120Hz adaptive refresh rate that makes every experience super smooth. Plus, details will stand out even in bright sunlight with anti reflective technology thanks to Corning Gorilla Glass with DX and Vision Booster that automatically detects light to adjust the screen.

feature_entries.title: From tasks to texts, all on your PC
feature_entries.description: Multitasking just got a lot more manageable. Whether you’re in a meeting or mid-brainstorm, your phone’s most important notifications are mirrored to your Galaxy Book5 Pro in real time. Check a message, answer a call or review recent mobile photos — all without switching screens or losing momentum. That means fewer distractions, faster replies and a smarter way to keep everything moving.²

feature_entries.title: Power through with less pauses
feature_entries.description: Just one charge helps keep you productive with the long-lasting battery of Galaxy Book5 Pro, supporting up to 25 hours of battery life.⁶ And when you need to power up plug in the compact charger to get up to 35% charge in just 30 minutes.

feature_entries.title: Get search results in a snap
feature_entries.description: AI Select lets you search right on your PC screen.¹ No need to type — simply trace an image, a text message or even a QR code on the screen using the cursor or your finger and get search results on the fly.

feature_entries.title: Remaster your photos with AI
feature_entries.description: Retouch images and clean up blurry photos in Samsung Gallery with Photo Remaster. This helpful tool uses a smart algorithm that gives all new life to your pics and makes every detail shine just like magic.

feature_entries.title: From first draft to fine art
feature_entries.description: Need a custom image for a presentation? Use Cocreator in Paint to sketch your idea and watch as AI transforms it into artwork.⁴ Edit, regenerate and apply finishing touches using simple prompts.

feature_entries.title: Go global with real time translations
feature_entries.description: Catch every word in conference calls with Live Captions.⁵ AI automatically detects speech in meetings and video streams and converts it into English captions in real time so you can easily follow along.

feature_entries.title: AI assistance is one press away
feature_entries.description: A single press is all it takes to launch Copilot the dedicated key on the keyboard of Galaxy Book5 Pro puts personalized AI assistance at your fingertips for instant access when you need it.

feature_entries.title: A fast and easy way to move files
feature_entries.description: Quick Share helps you skip the drag of email, cables and uploads³ Just select your file and send it directly to your Galaxy Book5 Pro laptop, phone or tablet. Whether you’re sending footage from your phone to your laptop or finalizing a presentation on your tablet before a meeting, Quick Share makes it simple to keep your files with you wherever you go.

feature_entries.title: Add your Tab as a second screen
feature_entries.description: Double your workspace by connecting Galaxy Tab as an additional display to your PC.⁷ Link the devices with just a click on your laptop, then take advantage of the extra space on Galaxy Tab with Extension, Duplicate and Rotation modes to rearrange your view.

feature_entries.title: Multiple devices, unified control
feature_entries.description: With Multi Control, use your Galaxy Book keyboard and trackpad to control your compatible Samsung tablet or smartphone simultaneously.⁸ Navigate through menus, access file and even drag and drop content between your Galaxy devices it's a seamless way to handle your workspace.

feature_entries.title: Premium. Portable. Pro.
feature_entries.description: Get the power you need to realize your ambitions in a sleek, lightweight body. Pick your size, pack it up and unleash greatness on the go.

feature_entries.title: Smarter touchpad. Multiple ports.
feature_entries.description: Easily navigate using the touchpad with adaptive palm rejection. Control your taps with precision thanks to palm monitoring on the subdivided palm area, reducing the chance of accidental touches. Plus, connect devices to your workstation using the two built in Thunderbolt 4 ports, HDMI, USB A, microSD card slot and Headphone/Mic.

feature_entries.title: Brighten up video calls with Staggered HDR
feature_entries.description: Jump into online meetings confidently with Staggered HDR. The webcam video stays crisp and vivid with a wide dynamic range so you are camera ready for calls in the office or on the go.

feature_entries.title: Amp up your sound experience with enhanced speakers
feature_entries.description: Boost your viewing experience with the rich and deep audio of the quad speaker system on Galaxy Book5 Pro, featuring large woofers that deliver rich bass sound. The four speakers are tuned with Dolby Atmos surround sound so you feel fully immersed.

feature_entries.title: Go full speed ahead with Wi Fi 7
feature_entries.description: Go online, stay online. Wi Fi 7 lets you connect reliably with lightning speed.⁹ Join online meetings, share updates and stay in touch easily with smooth real time interactions and ultra low latency.

feature_entries.title: Enjoy pro security with Samsung Knox
feature_entries.description: Safeguard your system with premium security from Samsung Knox. A dedicated security chip in the hardware is designed to shield your device in real time. Your laptop's critical system data can stay safe from potential threats and breaches.¹⁰

feature_entries.title: Connect from anywhere, automatically
feature_entries.description: The second you open Galaxy Book5 Pro, you’re already online. Auto Hotspot quickly tethers to your phone’s mobile data, letting you jump into video calls, upload files or edit presentations no matter where you are.⁴

feature_entries.title: 32GB LPDDR5x Memory (RAM)

feature_entries.description: Expanding the faster speeds and improved performance of Wi-Fi 6 into the 6 GHz band. Excellent for fast data transfers.

feature_entries.title: HyperX With Dual Speakers
feature_entries.description: Dual speakers surround you in immersive audio mixed and tuned by HyperX.

feature_entries.title: DTS: X Ultra Technology
feature_entries.description: Spatially accurate, 3D sound drops you into the middle of your favorite games, movies, and music with a level of depth and immersion you can feel.

feature_entries.title: 4-Zone RGB Keyboard
feature_entries.description: 26-key rollover anti-ghosting technology helps keep your in-game movements precise. Personalize the RGB 4-zone backlighting in OMEN Gaming Hub.

feature_entries.title: 1 Thunderbolt 4 With USB Type-C

products.page_description: Introducing the Lenovo ThinkPad E16 Gen 3, a sleek and durable laptop that delivers AI-POWERED PERFORMANCE to elevate productivity—equipped with Intel Core Ultra processors, it boasts unmatched AI capabilities for seamless workload optimization and handling even the most demanding tasks, while being built to meet the US Department of Defense's MIL-STD 810H standards to strike a perfect balance of reliability and durability. It further enhances its appeal with POWERFUL PERFORMANCE: powered by an Intel Core Ultra 7 255H Processor (boasting up to 5.1GHz and 16 cores) for superior efficiency and speed, paired with 32GB of DDR5 RAM to enable seamless multitasking and a 1TB PCIe NVMe M.2 SSD for fast storage that reduces load times, all working together to ensure smooth and responsive performance for every task. When it comes to CRISP DISPLAY & PRIVACY, the laptop features a 5MP webcam with a privacy shutter for crystal-clear video calls and enhanced security, while its 16" WUXGA (1920x1200) IPS display—boasting 300nits brightness and an anti-glare design, plus support from Intel Arc graphics—delivers crisp, vivid visuals; additionally, it can connect up to 3 external monitors via HDMI and Type-C ports at 4K (3840x2160) @60Hz without the need for a docking station. Complementing this is its VERSATILE CONNECTIVITY: it includes a fingerprint reader for enhanced security, is equipped with a comprehensive set of ports—Thunderbolt 4, USB-C 3.2 Gen 2x2, 2 x USB-A 3.2, Ethernet (RJ-45), HDMI 2.1, and an audio combo jack—for maximum peripheral flexibility, and features Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax) and Bluetooth 5.3 to ensure fast, reliable wireless performance. Finally, it runs on the OPERATING SYSTEM Windows 11 Professional 64-bit, complete with AI-powered Copilot that offers intelligent assistance for a variety of tasks, making it ideal for a wide range of users and scenarios including school education, designers, professionals, small businesses, programmers, casual gaming, streaming, online classes, remote learning, Zoom meetings, and video conferences. Brand New Computer has been resealed to upgrade the Memory/SSD.

products.page_description: Step into the future with Predator Helios Neo 16S AI—a gaming powerhouse crafted for versatility on the move. Built around an Intel Core Ultra processor, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti GPU with 992 AI TOPS, and a vibrant 16-inch OLED WQXGA display offering 240Hz refresh and 100% DCI-P3 color accuracy. Designed for style-conscious gamers and professionals, this ultra-slim machine (19.9mm) with a sleek profile that meets the demands for performance on the go.

feature_entries.title: Windows 11 Home
feature_entries.description: Windows 11 was designed with you at the center - to make life easier, more creative, secure, connected and fun! It's also faster with new features to help you get more done. Copilot in Windows complements your capabilities and creativity with intelligent assistance and relevant answers.

feature_entries.title: 16.0" WQXGA OLED 240Hz Refresh Rate (500 Nit)
feature_entries.description: At 16 inches with a 16:10 aspect ratio, the pristine WQXGA OLED screen offering true blacks utilizing VESA Certified True Black HDR500, vibrant colors with up to 100% DCI-P3 operates at a fast 240Hz refresh and 0.2ms response time. Alongside the suite of features from NVIDIA G-SYNC and NVIDIA Advanced Optimus, you're guaranteed that whatever's on-screen is a distinct viewing delight.

feature_entries.title: AI-Powered Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX Processor
feature_entries.description: Get legendary gaming performance with the Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX processor featuring 8 performance cores and 16 efficient cores, delivering ultra-smooth gameplay and future-ready AI (up to 13 NPU TOPS). Offload tasks like background removal and audio optimization to the NPU for seamless streaming and gaming, while Intel Application Optimization enhances performance on classic titles.

feature_entries.title: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU
feature_entries.description: Powered by NVIDIA Blackwell architecture, GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU (MGP 140W) unlocks the game-changing realism of full ray tracing. Equipped with a massive level of 992 AI TOPS horsepower, the RTX 50 Series enables new experiences and next-level graphics fidelity. Experience cinematic quality visuals at unprecedented speed with fourth-gen RT cores and breakthrough neural rendering technologies accelerated with fifth-gen Tensor cores.

feature_entries.title: NVIDIA DLSS 4
feature_entries.description: DLSS is a revolutionary suite of neural rendering technologies that uses AI to boost FPS, reduce latency, and improve image quality. DLSS 4 brings new Multi Frame Generation and enhanced Ray Reconstruction and Super Resolution, powered by GeForce RTX 50 Series GPUs and fifth-generation Tensor cores.

feature_entries.title: The Ultimate In Ray Tracing And AI
feature_entries.description: NVIDIA RTX is the most advanced platform for full ray tracing and neural rendering technologies that are revolutionizing the ways we play and create. Over 700 games and applications use RTX to deliver realistic graphics and incredibly fast performance with cutting-edge AI features like DLSS Multi Frame Generation.

feature_entries.title: 32GB DDR5 6400MHz Memory
feature_entries.description: 32GB DDR5 6400MHz memory - Used slots: 2 x 16GB | 0 slots (available) 2 DDR5 slots (total) - Maximum 64GB.

feature_entries.title: Slim Design
feature_entries.description: Crafted with a sleek profile, aluminum top and bottom and a z-height of under 19.9mm, this device seamlessly combines power and portability. Designed for style-conscious gamers and professionals, its ultra-slim build meets the demands of performance on the go.

feature_entries.title: Peak Performance Assured
feature_entries.description: Our advanced thermal solutions, driven by dual fans with one custom-engineered 5th Gen Aeroblade 3D metal fan combined with precision-applied liquid metal thermal compound, guarantee that your gaming or editing session remains at peak performance.

feature_entries.title: Killer Doubleshot Pro: Speed, Intelligence & Maximum Control
feature_entries.description: Enables Ethernet and Wi-Fi connections to work together for massive throughput (up to 5 Gbps) and unbeatable online performance. The Intel Killer E3100 Ethernet Controller and Intel Killer Wi-Fi 6E AX1675 boasts rapid channels in 2.4GHz, 5GHz and 6GHz bands spectra and significantly reduced latencies. Manage which applications are prioritized and monitor network usage through the dedicated Killer Control Center software.

feature_entries.title: AI-Assisted Noise Reduction
feature_entries.description: Elevate your team coordination using PurifiedVoice 2.0. This revolutionary tech leverages AI capabilities to eliminate unwanted background disturbances, delivering impeccable voice clarity. With the three microphone setup and beamforming, your commands stand out, free from other ambient noises.

feature_entries.title: Dynamic 4-Zone RGB Lighting
feature_entries.description: Personalize your rig with 4-zone RGB keyboard lighting and customizable cover illumination. Designed for those who want to make their setup as unique as their gameplay.

feature_entries.title: AI Experience
feature_entries.description: PredatorSense gives you real-time control over system performance—adjust performance modes, manage fan speeds, and customize RGB lighting with precision. In the Experience Zone, tap into AI-powered features like PurifiedView 2.0 for automatic framing and PurifiedVoice 2.0 for enhanced voice clarity.

feature_entries.title: PC Game Pass*
feature_entries.description: Play hundreds of PC games with your new Acer Predator Windows 11 PC and three months of PC Game Pass, including EA Play. With new games added all the time, there’s always something new to play. (*PC Game Pass: Subscription continues automatically at regular monthly price unless cancelled. products.page_description: Exceptionally powerful, ultrathin laptop — This Surface Laptop is not just faster—it’s more intuitive. Unlock your creativity and stay productive throughout the day with accelerated performance that powers a new AI era, enabling Copilot experiences deeply integrated with the Windows ecosystem. Enjoy all‑day battery life to keep your ideas flowing, and immerse yourself in stunning visuals on its modern, razor‑thin touchscreen display.

feature_entries.title: Copilot+ PCs. A new AI era begins
feature_entries.description: Turn your ideas from text prompts into generated artwork. With Recall*, search across time to find the content you need. Understand new languages instantly with Live Captions. Copilot+ PCs powered by the Snapdragon X Elite processor come with 45 Trillion Operations Per Second of NPU power, and they’re all set to transform the way you create, find and communicate.

feature_entries.title: Windows 11 Home is built for students and professionals
feature_entries.description: From a refreshed Start menu to new ways to connect with peers, news, games, and content, Windows 11 is designed to support learning, creativity, and everyday productivity in a way that feels natural.

feature_entries.title: 13.8" PixelSense Flow display with 2304 x 1536 resolution
feature_entries.description: Brilliant and more responsive touchscreen display with the thinnest bezels of any Surface. Enjoy smoother motions and swift interactions with up to 120HZ refresh rate.

feature_entries.title: Snapdragon X Elite (12 core) processors
feature_entries.description: The Snapdragon X Elite (12 core) Processor powering Copilot+ PCs ushers in a new era of performance, intelligence, and power efficiency for creators, collaborators, and engineers alike. Get astonishing processing speeds and power efficiency from a record-breaking CPU and NPU.

feature_entries.title: Qualcomm Adreno GPU
feature_entries.description: The integrated Qualcomm Adreno GPU delivers graphics-intensive presentations and entertainment.

feature_entries.title: Find your perfect match
feature_entries.description: Crafted with lightweight yet durable aluminum in four stunning colors¹; - Platinum, Black, and new Sapphire, and Dune.

feature_entries.title: AI-enhanced Studio Camera
feature_entries.description: The new HD 1080 Surface Studio Camera paris seamlessly with AI-powered Studio effects like automatic framing keeps you, or the whole family in focus, even as you move around your space.

feature_entries.title: Type with perfection
feature_entries.description: Experience impeccable typing—every keystroke perfected. With optimal key travel for accurate and swift typing. Let your thoughts flow with the satisfying sound and feel of typing.

feature_entries.title: Most inclusive touchpad
feature_entries.description: Built-in features to support users with disabilities including the adaptive touch mode in the Surface Precision Haptic touchpad.

feature_entries.title: All day battery life
feature_entries.description: With up to 20 hours of battery life⁶, Surface Laptop can keep up with whatever you need to do, wherever you need to do it, all day long.

feature_entries.title: The ports you need
feature_entries.description: Charge on-the-go, transfer data fast, or create the ultimate desktop set up with two USB-C 4 ports and support for up to three 4K monitors at 60Hz¹².

feature_entries.title: Designed with sustainability in mind
feature_entries.description: Made with more recycled materials than Surface Laptop 5, including a minimum of 67.2% recycled content in the enclosure⁸.

products.page_description: Big AI power. Simple to use. The MediaTek Kompanio Ultra’s 50 TOPS NPU boosts productivity and creativity with Smart Grouping, on-device image generation in the Gallery app, and more. The OLED display delivers crisp, vibrant visuals-perfect for photo editing and streaming-while quad Dolby Atmos speakers bring immersive audio. Thin, light, and built for self-starters, it lasts up to 17 hours.

feature_entries.title: Runs ChromeOS
feature_entries.description: The fast, secure operating system from Google with built-in Google apps like Gmail, Gemini, Docs, Photos, YouTube, and more, so you can go from deadlines to downtime straight out of the box.

feature_entries.title: Starts fast, won't slow you down
feature_entries.description: Chromebooks start up in under 10 seconds. And with up to 17 hours of battery life* and automatic updates, you can get things done without disruptions.

feature_entries.title: Google makes it easy
feature_entries.description: Sign in with your Gmail account and bam – all of your Google Drive files, photos, and Chrome bookmarks and preferences are ready to go.

feature_entries.title: Never had a virus**
feature_entries.description: Chromebooks have never had a virus so you can breathe easy knowing your security and privacy are covered with built-in protection and the Titan C2 security chip.***

feature_entries.title: The apps you love
feature_entries.description: Popular apps for streaming, gaming, creating, and staying organized are all available on Google Play. Easily access Microsoft 365, Minecraft, Adobe Express, and more.

feature_entries.title: Google AI Pro Plan, 12 Months
feature_entries.description: With the Google One AI Premium Plan, you get Gemini Advanced, 3TB of cloud storage, and Gemini in Gmail, Docs, and more - all on us when you purchase a Chromebook.

feature_entries.title: True colors, true sound
feature_entries.description: Experience visual brilliance with our 14" OLED display. Boasting 1920 x 1200 resolution and 100% DCI-P3 coverage, it delivers stunning clarity, vibrant colors, and lifelike images. Indulge yourself with three-dimensional sound in music, movies, and TV on the first ever Chromebook Plus with Dolby Atmos.

feature_entries.title: Fast, fluid, and future ready
feature_entries.description: Blaze through your day with unstoppable speed. Whether you’re editing photos, streaming, or on video calls, the MediaTek Kompanio Ultra processor and up to 16GB of memory keep things ultra-smooth.

feature_entries.title: The Magic of Gemini meets 50TOPs NPU
feature_entries.description: Save time typing your notes by letting Chromebook convert handwritten text to digital. Simplify jargon-filled content into everyday language. Get your questions answered by Gemini*. Customize wallpapers and video call backgrounds. With 50 TOPS NPU, unleash your creativity in the Gallery app.

feature_entries.title: One key for instant possibilities
feature_entries.description: Tap the Quick Insert key to enhance creativity in your content. Create custom high-resolution images, and get AI-generated writing support with Help me write. Add GIFs and emojis to emails, link a recent URL in a sheet, and quickly access your files - all without switching tabs or windows.

feature_entries.title: Go anywhere. Do anything. Stay powered
feature_entries.description: Light, sleek, and built to move. At just 15.8mm thin and 1.26kg (touchscreen), this Chromebook is effortless to carry, whether you’re hustling to class, working on-the-go or editing photos at a café. And with up to 17 hours of battery life plus Rapid Charge, you get 80% power in just an hour—because who has time to wait? Stay powered, stay productive, stay ahead.

feature_entries.title: Wireless network connectivity
feature_entries.description: High-speed wireless LAN built into the screen, so it connects to your network or hotspots on the most common Wi-Fi standards in both laptop and tablet modes.

feature_entries.title: Built-in HD webcam with microphone
feature_entries.description: Makes it easy to video chat with family and friends or teleconference with colleagues over Skype or other popular applications.
Note: This laptop does not include a built-in DVD/CD drive.

feature_entries.description: SUPERCHARGED BY M4 PRO OR M4 MAX—The M4 Pro chip blazes through demanding tasks like compiling millions of lines of code. M4 Max can handle the most challenging workflows like rendering intricate 3D content.

BUILT FOR APPLE INTELLIGENCE¹—Apple Intelligence is the personal intelligence system that helps you write, express yourself, and get things done effortlessly. With groundbreaking privacy protections, it gives you peace of mind that no one else can access your data—not even Apple.

PRIVACY AND SECURITY ARE BUILT RIGHT IN—Every Mac comes with robust defenses against viruses and malware. If your Mac is lost or stolen, Find My can help you get it back. FileVault makes sure your files are encrypted so others cannot access them. And free security updates help keep your Mac protected.

products.page_description: Meet ProArt PX13 – your go-to 13-inch convertible laptop, designed to effortlessly switch between forms, ready to fuel your creative passion whenever inspiration strikes. Its OLED touchscreen ensures precise color accuracy for flawless proofing, while versatile I/O ports seamlessly connect all your peripherals. This NVIDIA Studio-validated laptop packs GeForce RTX 4050 Laptop GPU and up to a 50 TOPS AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 processor, a pairing that will supercharge all your creative endeavors. With AI-enhanced creative features, military-grade toughness, and a long-lasting battery, ProArt PX13 transforms any setting into your studio.

feature_entries.title: Copilot+ PCs. A new AI era begins
feature_entries.description: New AI superpowers. Discover the power of Recall (preview), improved Windows search, and Click to Do (preview) on Copilot+ PCs. Effortlessly locate past content, perform natural searches, and interact with text and images – all while ensuring your data remains private and you stay productive*.

feature_entries.title: Powerful AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 processor
feature_entries.description: Step into the future of content creation with the AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX processor. Boasting up to 50 TOPs of NPU AI processing power, it delivers AI-enhanced efficiency.

feature_entries.title: Fast GeForce RTX 4050 graphics
feature_entries.description: Elevate your creations with lifelike detail and clarity at unprecedented speeds. With RTX-accelerated encoding, visual effects, faster rendering, smoother playback, real-time video editing, and 3D design, the ProArt PX13 empowers your artistic expression, leaving technical constraints behind.

feature_entries.title: 32GB RAM, more performance freedom
feature_entries.description: ProArt PX13 has massive RAM capacity, using fast LPDDR5X modules running at 7500 MHz, ensuring plenty of headroom to run all your other productivity tools.

feature_entries.title: 3K OLED Lumina touch display
feature_entries.description: Discover creativity without limits with the ProArt PX13, featuring the ASUS Lumina OLED touchscreen. This durable 3K OLED touchscreen with stylus support enhances projects with brilliant colors and fine details.

feature_entries.title: Copilot in Windows - Get answers, inspiration, and summaries
feature_entries.description: Find the relevant information and ideas you need to power your own ingenuity. Copilot in Windows 11 can deliver answers that are more relevant to you.

feature_entries.title: Exclusive ASUS DialPad for intuitive control
feature_entries.description: The customizable intuitive physical controller gives you fingertip control over parameters in your creative, productivity and media entertainment apps. You can easily change brush size in Photoshop, scroll through PowerPoint slides, or skip tracks in music apps.

feature_entries.title: Generate images with MuseTree
feature_entries.description: Articulate your vision or provide a simple sketch - and AI assists in crafting images to bring your vision to life.

feature_entries.title: One-stop file management with StoryCube
feature_entries.description: Use AI to automatically sort and categorize your digital photos or videos. Additionally, effortlessly share memories through automatically generated short videos.

feature_entries.title: Military-grade toughness
feature_entries.description: Crafted to conquer, ProArt PX13 exceeds the stringent MIL-STD 810H military standard, promising unparalleled durability and reliability. Engineered for the extremes, it guarantees longevity and sustainability, empowering you to work, travel, and unwind with absolute confidence.

feature_entries.title: Comprehensive I/O ports
feature_entries.description: There’s one 40 Gbps USB4 for fast charging and external displays, the latest HDMI 2.1 port; and an SD Express 7.0 card reader for quick transfers. Ultrafast Wi-Fi 7 ensures seamless connectivity anywhere.

products.page_description: HP OmniBook X 16" Next Gen AI PC: Designed to empower, built to perform, engineered to last. Experience enhanced AI processing, smoother graphics, and seamless multitasking powered by an Intel Core Ultra processor with Intel AI Boost delivering 50 NPU TOPS. Plus, this device meets military-grade standards and undergoes rigorous testing to handle drops, shocks, and extreme environments, keeping up with your toughest challenges so you never have to slow down.

feature_entries.title: Intel Core Ultra X7 358H processor with Intel AI Boost (50 NPU TOPS)
feature_entries.description: Brings breakthrough battery life, performance, AI efficiency, and built-in Intel Arc graphics for creators, gamers, and multitaskers who demand it all. That’s the power of Intel Inside.

feature_entries.title: 16-in 2K OLED touchscreen with 120Hz switchable refresh rate
feature_entries.description: Get sharper and more detailed visuals for editing and content creation with OLED, with 2048x1280 resolution, up to 400 Nits of brightness and 120Hz switchable refresh rate, so you can enjoy the clarity you want for all your creativity to flow.

feature_entries.title: 32 GB LPDDR5x Memory (RAM)
feature_entries.description: Low power double data rate 5x memory optimizes a mobile laptop device for smooth and frequent actions, ensuring it meets the needs for high performance and efficient power consumption.

feature_entries.title: Up to 19 hours and 30 minutes video playback battery life¹
feature_entries.description: One charge lasts a full day of mixed usage for all your work, school, and entertainment needs.

feature_entries.title: Intel Arc B390 Graphics
feature_entries.description: Get the speed for gaming, editing, rendering, and streaming, without the drain of a dedicated GPU. For creators and gamers, built-in Intel Arc graphics deliver all the power you need.

feature_entries.title: 1TB Solid State Drive (SSD) storage
feature_entries.description: With high-speed data transfer, the PCIe Gen4 NVMe M.2 SSD offers fast speed and efficient storage.

feature_entries.title: HP Fast Charge
feature_entries.description: In addition to long lasting battery life, this laptop optimizes charging to go from 0 to 50% in approximately 30 minutes².

feature_entries.title: Wi-Fi 7 (2x2) and Bluetooth 6.0 wireless card
feature_entries.description: Expect faster speeds, improved stability, and ultimate reliability when connecting multiple devices, even in crowded areas.

feature_entries.title: Windows 11 Home operating system
feature_entries.description: All the best elements of Windows 10, with added features to make it easier to log in to start working, gaming, or creating.

feature_entries.title: Microsoft Copilot
feature_entries.description: Do more with AI as your personal assistant. Kickstart new projects with relevant answers, simplified solutions, and helpful advice. Copilot in Windows 11 is ready to support you whenever and wherever you need it.

feature_entries.title: Exclusive on-device Copilot+ PC experiences
feature_entries.description: Copilot+ PC brings exclusive on-device AI experiences designed to accelerate productivity and creativity. With powerful performance for unique AI experiences and the most advanced Windows security, you can find mission-critical information fast, turn ideas into action, respond quickly to customers, and safeguard your most sensitive data.

feature_entries.title: HP 5MP IR Camera with HDR Switch
feature_entries.description: Take visually stunning works of art with HP 5MP IR Camera with HDR Switch capabilities. With High Dynamic Range and 16:10 aspect ratio you get HD content natively, so you can capture more gradients between lights and darks for truer color accuracy.

feature_entries.title: Full-Size Backlit backlit lattice-less keyboard with numeric keypad
feature_entries.description: Provides properly spaced keys, square forms and enlarged lettering. Optimized for precise typing.

feature_entries.title: Advanced AI Noise Reduction
feature_entries.description: Enjoy clearer team conversations with AI noise reduction. Using the Advanced Personal Mode, it tracks only your voice during conference calls while automatically filtering out noises and other speakers for distinctively focused communications.

feature_entries.title: Poly Camera Pro
feature_entries.description: Elevate your video calls with help from AI to enhance virtual interactions, customizable settings and professional grade features across all collaboration and streaming apps, without sacrificing performance or battery.

feature_entries.title: Smart Display with Screen Shift and Task Group features
feature_entries.description: Seamless multitasking on multiple displays with one-click to shift, snap, and launch windows where you want.

feature_entries.title: Ports
feature_entries.description: 1 USB Type-C (10Gbps signaling rate, USB Power Delivery 3.1, DisplayPort 1.4a, HP Sleep and Charge), 1 USB Type-A (10Gbps signaling rate), 1 USB Type-A (5Gbps signaling rate), 1 Headphone/microphone combo, 1 HDMI 2.1, 1 Thunderbolt 4 with USB Type-C (40Gbps signaling rate, USB Power Delivery 3.1, DisplayPort 2.1, HP Sleep and Charge)

feature_entries.title: Poly Studio Audio with dual speakers
feature_entries.description: HP + Poly together will continuously accelerate innovation across our hybrid solutions, including AI-generated technology. With pitch perfect audio, you'll get the best experience to collaborate anywhere with audio tuned by Poly Studio.

feature_entries.title: HP Audio Boost 2.0
feature_entries.description: Feel and hear state-of-the-art sound with the next generation of HP Audio Boost powered by Smart Amp technology—providing louder, richer sound and making music or sound effects feel more dynamic.

feature_entries.title: DTS: X Ultra Technology
feature_entries.description: Spatially accurate, 3D sound drops you into the middle of your favorite games, movies, and music with a level of depth and immersion you can feel.

feature_entries.title: Screen Distance and Screen Time
feature_entries.description: Offers a customized experience to support the wellbeing of the whole family. Manage reminders for balanced productivity and encourage proper posture while minimizing eyestrain.

feature_entries.title: Making responsible choices
feature_entries.description: Designed using responsible materials like ocean-bound and post-consumer recycled plastic to help drive progress toward a more sustainable future.

feature_entries.title: Weighs 4.60 lbs. and measures 0.59" thin
feature_entries.description: A portable and lightweight design that fits perfectly in your lap, so you're never tethered to one place. 4-cell, 70 Wh Li-ion polymer battery.

feature_entries.title: Enjoy 2 months of Xbox Game Pass Premium

products.page_description: Galaxy Book5 Pro gives you premium performance and pro-level power in a device designed to move as fast as you do. From creating presentations to editing large files, the AI-powered Intel Core Ultra 7 processor makes it all feel unbelievably fast and smooth. With its lightweight build and long-lasting battery, you can seamlessly transition from your desk to a cafe to a client meeting without missing a beat. Packed with cutting-edge technology, Book5 Pro has smart features like AI Select¹ and Copilot AI assistance to help you simplify complex tasks and streamline your workflow. Because work rarely happens on just one device, Book5 Pro is also built with advanced features that make it easy to work in sync with the rest of your Galaxy devices. Get an important notification or need to respond to a text mid-project? Phone Link ² puts your phone screen right on Book5 Pro, allowing you to access all your important phone features and control it right from your PC. Sharing big files between your devices? With Quick Share³ you can do it wirelessly, quickly and safely. Plus, Auto Hotspot⁴ kicks in when your Wi-Fi doesn’t, so your laptop stays connected even when your day takes a detour. No matter where work takes you, Galaxy Book5 Pro keeps you a step ahead.

feature_entries.title: Copilot+ PCs. A new AI era begins.
feature_entries.description: Turn your ideas from text prompts into generated artwork. With Recall*, search across time to find the content you need. Understand new languages instantly with Live Captions. With Copilot+ PCs, you will be all set to transform the way you create, find and communicate. Some Copilot+ PC experiences require free updates continuing to roll out through early 2025. Timing varies by device and region. See aka.ms/copilotpluspcs

feature_entries.title: Get a fresh perspective with Windows 11
feature_entries.description: From a rejuvenated Start menu, to new ways to connect to your favorite people, news, games, and content—Windows 11 is the place to think, express, and create in a natural way.

feature_entries.title: The latest Intel processor driving this next gen AI PC
feature_entries.description: Experience a new level of transformative AI performance on Galaxy Book5 Pro with the super fast Intel Core Ultra processor (Series 2), upgraded graphics and an advanced NPU capable of up to 47 TOPS. Harness all that power to blaze through heavy workloads, render complex models and easily complete AI-intensive tasks with incredible speed.

feature_entries.title: Vivid visuals and dazzling views at your fingertips
feature_entries.description: From detailed presentations to enjoying vibrant content, it all looks captivating on the 3K Dynamic AMOLED 2x display with touchscreen, featuring 120Hz adaptive refresh rate that makes every experience super smooth. Plus, details will stand out even in bright sunlight with anti reflective technology thanks to Corning Gorilla Glass with DX and Vision Booster that automatically detects light to adjust the screen.

feature_entries.title: From tasks to texts, all on your PC
feature_entries.description: Multitasking just got a lot more manageable. Whether you’re in a meeting or mid-brainstorm, your phone’s most important notifications are mirrored to your Galaxy Book5 Pro in real time. Check a message, answer a call or review recent mobile photos — all without switching screens or losing momentum. That means fewer distractions, faster replies and a smarter way to keep everything moving.²

feature_entries.title: Power through with less pauses
feature_entries.description: Just one charge helps keep you productive with the long-lasting battery of Galaxy Book5 Pro, supporting up to 21 hours of battery life.⁶ And when you need to power up plug in the compact charger to get up to 35% charge in just 30 minutes.

feature_entries.title: Get search results in a snap
feature_entries.description: AI Select lets you search right on your PC screen.¹ No need to type — simply trace an image, a text message or even a QR code on the screen using the cursor or your finger and get search results on the fly.

feature_entries.title: Remaster your photos with AI
feature_entries.description: Retouch images and clean up blurry photos in Samsung Gallery with Photo Remaster. This helpful tool uses a smart algorithm that gives all new life to your pics and makes every detail shine just like magic.

feature_entries.title: From first draft to fine art
feature_entries.description: Need a custom image for a presentation? Use Cocreator in Paint to sketch your idea and watch as AI transforms it into artwork.⁴ Edit, regenerate and apply finishing touches using simple prompts.

feature_entries.title: Go global with real time translations
feature_entries.description: Catch every word in conference calls with Live Captions.⁵ AI automatically detects speech in meetings and video streams and converts it into English captions in real time so you can easily follow along.

feature_entries.title: AI assistance is one press away
feature_entries.description: A single press is all it takes to launch Copilot the dedicated key on the keyboard of Galaxy Book5 Pro puts personalized AI assistance at your fingertips for instant access when you need it.

feature_entries.title: A fast and easy way to move files
feature_entries.description: Quick Share helps you skip the drag of email, cables and uploads³ Just select your file and send it directly to your Galaxy Book5 Pro laptop, phone or tablet. Whether you’re sending footage from your phone to your laptop or finalizing a presentation on your tablet before a meeting, Quick Share makes it simple to keep your files with you wherever you go.

feature_entries.title: Add your Tab as a second screen
feature_entries.description: Double your workspace by connecting Galaxy Tab as an additional display to your PC.⁷ Link the devices with just a click on your laptop, then take advantage of the extra space on Galaxy Tab with Extension, Duplicate and Rotation modes to rearrange your view.

feature_entries.title: Multiple devices, unified control
feature_entries.description: With Multi Control, use your Galaxy Book keyboard and trackpad to control your compatible Samsung tablet or smartphone simultaneously.⁸ Navigate through menus, access file and even drag and drop content between your Galaxy devices it's a seamless way to handle your workspace.

feature_entries.title: Premium. Portable. Pro.
feature_entries.description: Get the power you need to realize your ambitions in a sleek, lightweight body. Pick your size, pack it up and unleash greatness on the go.

feature_entries.title: Smarter touchpad. Multiple ports.
feature_entries.description: Easily navigate using the touchpad with adaptive palm rejection. Control your taps with precision thanks to palm monitoring on the subdivided palm area, reducing the chance of accidental touches. Plus, connect devices to your workstation using the two built in Thunderbolt 4 ports, HDMI, USB A, microSD card slot and Headphone/Mic.

feature_entries.title: Brighten up video calls with Staggered HDR
feature_entries.description: Jump into online meetings confidently with Staggered HDR. The webcam video stays crisp and vivid with a wide dynamic range so you are camera ready for calls in the office or on the go.

feature_entries.title: Amp up your sound experience with enhanced speakers
feature_entries.description: Boost your viewing experience with the rich and deep audio of the quad speaker system on Galaxy Book5 Pro, featuring large woofers that deliver rich bass sound. The four speakers are tuned with Dolby Atmos surround sound so you feel fully immersed.

feature_entries.title: Go full speed ahead with Wi Fi 7
feature_entries.description: Go online, stay online. Wi Fi 7 lets you connect reliably with lightning speed.⁹ Join online meetings, share updates and stay in touch easily with smooth real time interactions and ultra low latency.

feature_entries.title: Enjoy pro security with Samsung Knox
feature_entries.description: Safeguard your system with premium security from Samsung Knox. A dedicated security chip in the hardware is designed to shield your device in real time. Your laptop's critical system data can stay safe from potential threats and breaches.¹⁰

feature_entries.title: Connect from anywhere, automatically
feature_entries.description: The second you open Galaxy Book5 Pro, you’re already online. Auto Hotspot quickly tethers to your phone’s mobile data, letting you jump into video calls, upload files or edit presentations no matter where you are.⁴

Built with Windows 11 Home 64-bit and AI-powered Copilot, it is ideal for professionals, Small Business and programmers, offering seamless support for remote work, content creation, video conferencing (Zoom/streaming), and educational applications. Brand New Computer has been resealed to upgrade the Memory/SSD.
